title: Context Engine And Isolated Automation
goal: Add additive context-engine preview hooks and automation session-target closure without bypassing approval, evidence, or the canonical fallback context path.

implementationWorkers.title: Add context-engine preview hooks and automation session-target support

repairWorker.title: Diagnose context and automation blockers without bypassing audit, approval, or canonical fallback behavior

successCriteria: Context engine hooks stay additive and preserve default fallback behavior.
Automation session targets remain approval- and evidence-aware.
No second context assembly authority or shadow automation runtime is introduced.

forbiddenBoundaries.description: Phase 5 must not introduce hidden runtime bypasses around evidence or approval.

notes: Phase 5 stays additive: preview hooks may extend context assembly, but the default workspace-context path remains canonical fallback.
Automation session-target work must reuse the existing agent runtime/session authority instead of introducing a parallel scheduler or delivery subsystem.
